spacing.$description: Component and control spacing (4px base, 2px and 6px half-steps). Same value on every platform. For space between components use platform.spacing.layout.*.

none.$description: Component · 0. Use for: explicitly removing padding or gap — flush lists, joined segments (split button: the parts touch and a Divider separates them), edge-to-edge media. Not for: hiding content.

xxs.$description: Component · 2px optical nudge. Use for: badge offset on an avatar or icon, status dot position, gap between stacked lines in dense data. Not for: padding of anything interactive or gaps between interactive elements.

xs.$description: Component · Tight gap inside a component. Use for: icon-to-text in badges, chips and inline links; title-to-description in list items and card headers; badge padding; field-to-supporting-text gap. Not for: control padding (use control/*) or gaps between separate interactive elements (use md or more).

sm.$description: Component · Compact gap. Use for: label-to-field gap, compact chip and tag padding, icon-to-text in small non-control elements. Not for: layout or control padding.

md.$description: Component · Default small gap. Use for: tooltip and popover padding, gap between related interactive elements (button group, chip row, toolbar icon buttons), dense list-row vertical padding, menu item gap. Not for: card, dialog or panel padding (use layout/container).

lg.$description: Component · Comfortable gap. Use for: list-row padding, menu padding-inline, avatar-to-text gap in list items, gap between the parts of a component (toast header and body). Not for: space between components on a page (use layout/*).

xl.$description: Component · Large gap inside a component. Use for: list-row and menu-row padding-inline on touch, content-to-action gap in banners and snackbars, table cell padding-inline. Not for: container edges of cards, dialogs and panels (use layout/container).

2xl.$description: Component · Extra-large gap inside a large component, when xl is too tight and 3xl too loose — side sheet header padding, empty-state content gap. Rare. Not for: layout.

3xl.$description: Component · Largest step inside a component that owns its own spacing — navigation drawer header, illustration-to-text in empty states. Not for: card or dialog padding, which changes per platform (use layout/container).

control.$description: Control · Spacing inside controls with a fixed height (Button, Icon button, Split button, Text field, Select, Segmented button). The step always equals the control size: a md control uses padding-inline.md and gap.md. Use with size.control.height.*.

sm.$description: Control · Horizontal padding of sm (32px) controls. Dense web only: tables, toolbars, filters. Never mix with another size.

md.$description: Control · Horizontal padding of md (40px) controls. Default on web.

lg.$description: Control · Horizontal padding of lg (48px) controls. Default on tablet and mobile.

xl.$description: Control · Horizontal padding of xl (56px) controls. Tablet and mobile primary actions only.

padding-inline.$description: Control · Horizontal padding inside a control. The step always equals the control size.

gap.$description: Control · Icon-to-label gap inside a control. The step always equals the control size.

sm.$description: Control · Icon-to-label gap in sm (32px) controls.

md.$description: Control · Icon-to-label gap in md (40px) controls. Default on web.

lg.$description: Control · Icon-to-label gap in lg (48px) controls. Default on tablet and mobile.

xl.$description: Control · Icon-to-label gap in xl (56px) controls.
